name: N-Methylhexedrone
summary: N-Methylhexedrone (NMH) is a synthetic cathinone stimulant with limited research and human-use evidence.
dosageRemark: Oral threshold at 30 mg, light at 50 - 70 mg, common at 70 - 100 mg, strong at 100 - 125 mg, and heavy at 125 mg or more. Its disclaimer says these educational ranges were compiled from users and resources and should be checked against other sources; the page also says most available NMH risk data are speculative or based on user experience. These low-confidence figures are not recommendations.
generalRisks: NMH has not been sufficiently studied, and available risk information is largely speculative or based on user experience; it urges particular caution about potentially serious long-term harms.
addictionPotential: Moderate addictive potential and high abuse potential, with possible psychological dependence.

tolerance.full: Tolerance to many effects develops with sustained and repeated use.
